items.name: Wood
items.desc: Fallen branches, dry enough to work.

items.name: Stone
items.desc: River stone and quarry chips.

items.name: Clay
items.desc: Cool clay from the bank.

items.name: Fibre
items.desc: Reed and herb fibre, stripped and drying.

items.name: Hide
items.desc: Shed hide from the racks. Nothing was killed for it.

items.name: Iron ore
items.desc: Dark ore. The dream will not yield it yet.

items.name: Loaf
items.desc: A round loaf from the tandoor.

items.name: Wooden mallet
items.desc: A first tool. Heavy and honest.

items.name: Stone knife
items.desc: A flint edge bound with fibre.

items.name: Gathering hook
items.desc: A curved stick for reeds and branches.

items.name: Hand axe
items.desc: For branches, not for people.

items.name: Stone pick
items.desc: A stone point on a short haft.

items.name: Wooden spoon
items.desc: Carved smooth, the way Hama makes them.

items.name: Spoon mould
items.desc: A wooden mould so the spoons come out kin to each other.

items.name: Clay cup
items.desc: Unfired, still cool in the hand.

items.name: Clay bowl
items.desc: A wide bowl for the shelf.

items.name: Water jar
items.desc: A jar with a fibre neck.

items.name: Wooden stool
items.desc: Three legs and a round seat.

items.name: Stone lamp
items.desc: A hollow stone with a fibre wick.

items.name: Spirit braid
items.desc: Four strands, for the spring.

items.name: Hide satchel
items.desc: A small satchel of shed hide and reed fibre.

items.name: Hand millstone
items.desc: A round stone that remembers grain.

items.name: Old basket
items.desc: A worn reed basket from a doorway.

items.name: Broken pot
items.desc: Sherds of a household pot. Still good clay.

items.name: Worn rug
items.desc: A rug whose colours have dreamed themselves thin.

items.name: Cracked jug
items.desc: A water jug with a patient crack.

items.name: Windmill
items.desc: An invention for a later waking. The sails are not in this dream.

items.name: Water wheel
items.desc: An invention for a later waking. The wheel is only a foundation.

items.name: Black-powder rocket
items.desc: An old sealed recipe. It stays shut until a later part.
